findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_hub_catalog, extract_clean_markdown · Private data: extract_clean_markdown, audit_crypto_token, generate_outreach_dossier, chain_token_balance, chain_token_info, company_filings, entity_company, token_verdict · Public sink: generate_outreach_dossier · Destructive: audit_technical_seo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_hub_catalog, extract_clean_markdown · Private data: extract_clean_markdown, audit_crypto_token, generate_outreach_dossier, chain_token_balance, chain_token_info, company_filings, entity_company, token_verdict · Public sink: generate_outreach_dossier · Destructive: audit_technical_seo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
